searchText: How do you sweep accounts post 1559 since you always set “max fee”? Are Wallets adding “exactly x fee” as well? It’s more of a ui/ux thing if you set max fee == premium you should be guaranteed to pay exactly max fee (this is how pre-1559 transactions will be cast once 1559 goes live too) what would that exactly do? base fee + high miner tip ? Yes basically you’d pay max fee and the miner gets anything between base fee and max fee gotcha, thanks!
